product.name: MARC (Modular Actuation Receptor Cells)
product.description: Synthetic immune receptors designed to improve efficacy and safety in cell therapies by preventing early T cell exhaustion and enhancing persistence.

product.name: Modular Vector (MoVE) platform
product.description: A delivery system using immune cell-specific vectors for in vivo administration and activation of MARC in T cells, NK cells, and other immune cells.
